h: Content creator Genevieve urges Nigerians to stop voting along tribal lines
p: Creator Genevieve has urged voters to put competence and good governance ahead of ethnic loyalty in 2027, in a message that reportedly criticised some Tinubu supporters.
more: Her post has drawn mixed reactions online.
Several creators have been weighing in on the 2027 race.
